note.en: Reading used: a VIP is a customer whose lifetime spend is at least $500 or who has at least 5 orders (glossary definition). Count, revenue and AOV cover those customers' order items created in the last 30 days, grouped by the customer's traffic source.
note.ko: 적용한 해석: VIP는 누적 구매액이 $500 이상이거나 주문이 5건 이상인 고객입니다(Glossary 정의). 고객 수, 매출, AOV는 이 고객들의 최근 30일 Order Item을 고객의 Traffic Source별로 집계했습니다.

label.en: VIP customers by traffic source, last 30 days

queries.sql:
WITH vip AS (
  SELECT user_id
  FROM `ryan-sandbox-agent.cymbal_enterprise_dw.order_items`
  GROUP BY user_id
  HAVING SUM(sale_price) >= 500 OR COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) >= 5
),
vip_30d AS (
  SELECT u.traffic_source,
         COUNT(DISTINCT oi.user_id) AS vip_customer_count,
         ROUND(SUM(oi.sale_price), 2) AS total_gross_revenue,
         ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(oi.sale_price), COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id)), 2) AS average_order_value
  FROM `ryan-sandbox-agent.cymbal_enterprise_dw.order_items` AS oi
  JOIN vip USING (user_id)
  JOIN `ryan-sandbox-agent.cymbal_enterprise_dw.users` AS u ON u.id = oi.user_id
  WHERE oi.created_at >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
  GROUP BY u.traffic_source
)
SELECT * FROM vip_30d ORDER BY total_gross_revenue DESC

note.en: Assumes the previous turn was the default S1 question. Reading used here: all three S1 columns stay restricted to VIP customers (Search gross revenue ~$88.3K), joined with 14-day cart sessions and cart abandonment rate (%) from events by traffic source. Both pipelines often compute gross revenue and AOV across all customers in each channel (~$608.5K for Search) while keeping vip_customer_count VIP-only — an ambiguity in the follow-up wording rather than a join failure.
note.ko: 직전 Turn이 S1 기본 질문이었다고 가정합니다. 이 기준 SQL은 S1의 세 Column을 모두 VIP 고객 한정(Search 매출 약 $88.3K)으로 유지한 뒤 events의 최근 14일 Cart Session 수와 이탈률을 결합했습니다. 반면 두 Pipeline은 후속 질문 해석 시 VIP 고객 수만 VIP로 두고 매출·AOV는 채널 전체 고객 기준(Search 약 $608.5K)으로 집계하는 경우가 많으며, 이는 후속 질문 표현의 모호성에 따른 해석 차이입니다.

label.en: VIP columns plus 14-day cart sessions and abandonment
label.ko: VIP Column + 14일 Cart Session 및 이탈률

queries.sql:
WITH vip AS (
  SELECT user_id
  FROM `ryan-sandbox-agent.cymbal_enterprise_dw.order_items`
  GROUP BY user_id
  HAVING SUM(sale_price) >= 500 OR COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) >= 5
),
vip_30d AS (
  SELECT u.traffic_source,
         COUNT(DISTINCT oi.user_id) AS vip_customer_count,
         ROUND(SUM(oi.sale_price), 2) AS total_gross_revenue,
         ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(oi.sale_price), COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id)), 2) AS average_order_value
  FROM `ryan-sandbox-agent.cymbal_enterprise_dw.order_items` AS oi
  JOIN vip USING (user_id)
  JOIN `ryan-sandbox-agent.cymbal_enterprise_dw.users` AS u ON u.id = oi.user_id
  WHERE oi.created_at >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
  GROUP BY u.traffic_source
),
sessions AS (
  SELECT session_id, traffic_source,
         MAX(IF(event_type = 'cart', 1, 0)) AS has_cart,
         MAX(IF(event_type = 'purchase', 1, 0)) AS has_purchase
  FROM `ryan-sandbox-agent.cymbal_enterprise_dw.events`
  WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 14 DAY)
  GROUP BY session_id, traffic_source
),
cart_14d AS (
  SELECT traffic_source,
         COUNT(DISTINCT IF(has_cart = 1, session_id, NULL)) AS cart_sessions_14d,
         ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT IF(has_cart = 1 AND has_purchase = 0, session_id, NULL)) * 100.0,
                           COUNT(DISTINCT IF(has_cart = 1, session_id, NULL))), 2) AS cart_abandonment_rate_pct
  FROM sessions
  GROUP BY traffic_source
)
SELECT v.traffic_source, v.vip_customer_count, v.total_gross_revenue, v.average_order_value,
       c.cart_sessions_14d, c.cart_abandonment_rate_pct
FROM vip_30d AS v
LEFT JOIN cart_14d AS c USING (traffic_source)
ORDER BY v.total_gross_revenue DESC

note.en: Reading used: no date or product filter. Lead time is the average whole days from shipped to delivered over all delivered order items, by the distribution center of the product. Holding cost is the summed cost of inventory rows that have no sold date.
note.ko: 적용한 해석: 기간과 상품 조건 없이 전체 데이터를 대상으로 했습니다. Lead Time은 배송 완료된 모든 Order Item의 출고~배송 일수 평균이며 상품의 Distribution Center 기준입니다. Holding Cost는 판매일이 없는 Inventory 행의 원가 합계입니다.

label.en: Lead time and unsold inventory cost by distribution center
label.ko: Distribution Center별 Lead Time 및 미판매 재고 원가

queries.sql:
WITH lead AS (
  SELECT p.distribution_center_id AS dc_id,
         ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(oi.delivered_at, oi.shipped_at, DAY)), 2) AS avg_delivery_lead_time_days,
         COUNT(*) AS delivered_items
  FROM `ryan-sandbox-agent.cymbal_enterprise_dw.order_items` AS oi
  JOIN `ryan-sandbox-agent.cymbal_enterprise_dw.products` AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
  WHERE oi.shipped_at IS NOT NULL AND oi.delivered_at IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY dc_id
),
unsold AS (
  SELECT product_distribution_center_id AS dc_id,
         ROUND(SUM(IF(sold_at IS NULL, cost, 0)), 2) AS unsold_inventory_holding_cost
  FROM `ryan-sandbox-agent.cymbal_enterprise_dw.inventory_items`
  GROUP BY dc_id
)
SELECT dc.name AS distribution_center, l.avg_delivery_lead_time_days, l.delivered_items,
       u.unsold_inventory_holding_cost
FROM `ryan-sandbox-agent.cymbal_enterprise_dw.distribution_centers` AS dc
LEFT JOIN lead AS l ON l.dc_id = dc.id
LEFT JOIN unsold AS u ON u.dc_id = dc.id
ORDER BY dc.id

queries.sql:
SELECT u.traffic_source, COUNT(*) AS dormant_customer_count
FROM `ryan-sandbox-agent.cymbal_enterprise_dw.users` AS u

  SELECT 1 FROM `ryan-sandbox-agent.cymbal_enterprise_dw.orders` AS o

label.en: (2) Margin, return rate and realized profit by brand

queries.sql:
SELECT p.brand,
       ROUND(AVG(SAFE_DIVIDE(p.retail_price - p.cost, p.retail_price) * 100), 2) AS unit_gross_margin_pct,
       ROUND(COUNTIF(oi.status IN ('Returned', 'Cancelled')) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS return_and_cancellation_rate_pct,
       ROUND(SUM(IF(oi.status NOT IN ('Returned', 'Cancelled'), oi.sale_price - p.cost, 0)), 2) AS realized_gross_profit,
       COUNT(*) AS order_items
FROM `ryan-sandbox-agent.cymbal_enterprise_dw.order_items` AS oi
JOIN `ryan-sandbox-agent.cymbal_enterprise_dw.products` AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE oi.order_id >= 9900000
  AND p.department = 'Women' AND p.category = 'Outerwear & Coats'
GROUP BY p.brand
ORDER BY p.brand

note.en: Reading used: net sales is the sum of ss_ext_sales_price and net profit the sum of ss_net_profit (glossary), by the year of the sale date. Sales rows without a sale date are left out. The retail channel data is fixed (1998 to 2003), so these values do not change over time.
note.ko: 적용한 해석: Net Sales는 ss_ext_sales_price 합계, Net Profit은 ss_net_profit 합계이며(Glossary) 판매일의 연도로 묶었습니다. 판매일이 없는 행은 제외했습니다. 소매 채널 데이터는 1998~2003년 고정값이라 시간이 지나도 바뀌지 않습니다.

label.en: Store channel net sales and net profit by year
label.ko: Store 채널 연도별 Net Sales와 Net Profit

queries.sql:
SELECT d.d_year AS year,
       ROUND(SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price), 2) AS net_sales,
       ROUND(SUM(ss.ss_net_profit), 2) AS net_profit
FROM `ryan-sandbox-agent.cymbal_enterprise_dw.store_sales` AS ss
JOIN `ryan-sandbox-agent.cymbal_enterprise_dw.date_dim` AS d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk

note.en: Reading used: net profit of each channel (ss_net_profit, cs_net_profit, ws_net_profit) by the year of the sale date, one row per year. The three fact tables are aggregated separately and joined on the year. Answering this in one query needs tables of three domains, so the To-Be router sends it to the warehouse-wide data agent.
note.ko: 적용한 해석: 채널별 Net Profit(ss_net_profit, cs_net_profit, ws_net_profit)을 판매일의 연도로 묶어 연도당 한 행으로 냈습니다. Fact Table 세 개를 각각 집계한 뒤 연도로 Join했습니다. 한 Query로 답하려면 세 Domain의 Table이 필요하므로 To-Be Router는 Warehouse 전체 Data Agent로 보냅니다.

label.en: Net profit by year: store, catalog and web
label.ko: 연도별 Net Profit: Store, Catalog, Web

queries.sql:
WITH store AS (
  SELECT d.d_year AS year, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS net_profit
  FROM `ryan-sandbox-agent.cymbal_enterprise_dw.store_sales` AS ss JOIN `ryan-sandbox-agent.cymbal_enterprise_dw.date_dim` AS d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  GROUP BY year
),
catalog AS (
  SELECT d.d_year AS year, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS net_profit
  FROM `ryan-sandbox-agent.cymbal_enterprise_dw.catalog_sales` AS cs JOIN `ryan-sandbox-agent.cymbal_enterprise_dw.date_dim` AS d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  GROUP BY year
),
web AS (
  SELECT d.d_year AS year, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS net_profit
  FROM `ryan-sandbox-agent.cymbal_enterprise_dw.web_sales` AS ws JOIN `ryan-sandbox-agent.cymbal_enterprise_dw.date_dim` AS d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  GROUP BY year
)
SELECT store.year,
       ROUND(store.net_profit, 2) AS store_net_profit,
       ROUND(catalog.net_profit, 2) AS catalog_net_profit,
       ROUND(web.net_profit, 2) AS web_net_profit
FROM store
JOIN catalog USING (year)
JOIN web USING (year)
ORDER BY year

questions: compare net profit by year across the retail store, catalog and web channels side by side in one table.
